title: Do the deployed engines' modelled rebalance-close fills sit anywhere unusual in their week, and do the lines bought give anything back after the fill?
unit: rebalance date x line x side; a line is one sleeve's universe member (sleeve A's panel ids priced on their registry trading proxies, B and C tickers, sleeve D's panel ids priced on the Xetra lines) or one overlay leg (TILT:EEM, GATE:SHY); a sleeve fill and an overlay-induced fill on one line, date and side aggregate into one unit carried with both kinds (amendment 6)

placebo.price_rule: the placebo session's unadjusted close, on its own basis (amendment a: the fills are closes)
placebo.price_rule_disclosure: uniform inside the placebo session's unadjusted low-high range (the PCC study's primary rule), on the same offsets and the same random-number stream; a disclosure cell
placebo.structure: blocked: fills on one rebalance date (session date) form one cluster (amendment 2); in each placebo set every member of a cluster takes the same offset, drawn from the offsets eligible for all of them; the independent-per-fill null and the PCC engine's chained same-line null (same-line seven-session windows that overlap joined) are computed at 1,000 draws as disclosures only. Stated limit: consecutive weekly fills on one line share two bars of their windows, a serial overlap the date blocks treat as independent; their post legs share no bar

independent_per_fill.note: the PCC engine's comparison null, same seed offset and draws

chained_same_line.note: the relation first registered and dropped by amendment 2

bootstrap_unit: cluster (block bootstrap over the same clusters as the null)
verdict_bearing: H-D2 alone, on the confirmatory set; H-D1 is the descriptive headline and decides nothing

floors.H_D2_floor_basis: an economic floor of 10 bp of price (amendment 3); the reason as ruled is the lab's modelled one-way cost per unit of traded notional, recorded with the correction that 10 bp is the blend's modelled round trip (5 bp each way)
floors.H_D1_note: descriptive: the reference floor is the blocked null's MDE at 0.80 power rounded up to 0.01 in u

power_rule: a clause with power below 0.80 at its floor is demoted: a demoted fail reads UNRESOLVED, a demoted pass reads SUGGESTIVE; H-D2's floor is economic, so its power is a measurement on the blocked null

thinness.rule: the H-D2 effect on the confirmatory set recomputed with each line, and each calendar year, dropped in turn; thinness fires when the leave-one-out effects straddle zero (the PCC engine's S9 test)
thinness.scope_note: amendment 4: thinness guards a pass only (GIVE-BACK-AT-SIZE or GIVE-BACK-BELOW-SIZE); a failing H-D2 carries no thinness suffix

dividend_handling.primary: rebase every bar of the window to the fill session's adjustment factor f = ac / c, so prices on both sides of an ex-date are on one basis

alignment.rule: a fill whose price lies outside its dated session's low-high range beyond the tolerance is re-dated to the adjacent session whose range holds it (previous session preferred), and counted; a fill that fits neither adjacent session is excluded. The fills here are priced at their own session's close, so the rule can act only on a defective bar.

bar_defects.fabricated_bar: open = high = low = close equal to the last good close (a no-trade or holiday bar)
bar_defects.range_repair: a session's range must contain its own open and close; where the vendor prints a high below the open or a low above the close, the range is widened to the prints it reports and the bar is counted as repaired, not dropped
bar_defects.bad_print_rule: a close more than the jump away from the last good close that the NEXT close reverts to within half the jump of that level; a move the next bar does not revert is a move, not a print

explicit_exclusions.reason: carried from the PCC spec; inert here (no such line)

exclusions: adapter: BTC-USD in sleeve C (seven-day calendar), counted
adapter (guard 2): a fill date that is not a session in the line's fetched series, counted

adapter (parity guard, amendment 1): a line whose fetched adjusted close disagrees with the engine's own price panel (read locally from the automation clone; the tilt's EEM leg from its committed panel) beyond 0.1 per cent on any of its fill dates, its fills excluded and counted; a line with no panel anywhere declared unchecked and counted
engine: no feed symbol, or symbol absent from the bars extract
engine: proxy feed (the book meta's exchange is not the market of the feed symbol's suffix)
engine: alignment (price outside its dated session's range and both neighbours')
engine: window of seven sessions incomplete (edge of history, a defective or provisional bar inside it)

inputs_frozen_as_extracts.fills: results/fills.json, written by scripts/ws_fill_placement_adapter.py from the published weekly weight vectors, in the PCC trades.json row shape
inputs_frozen_as_extracts.book: results/book_meta.json, the minimal book meta (ticker, yf, exchange code, ccy, type) with the adapter's provenance
inputs_frozen_as_extracts.bars: results/bars_used.json, yfinance unadjusted OHLC and adjusted close per priced line, with a provenance header

fx: unit (amendment b): every rate 1.0; notional is |dw| x NAV in NAV units
stop_conditions_mechanical: bars_used.json sha256 differs from coverage.json (the FX key compares the unit-FX constant)
fills.json or book_meta.json sha256 differs from coverage.json
complete fill count differs from coverage.json
any placebo matrix or any actual score holds a missing value
the vectorised placebo path and the scalar actual path disagree beyond 1e-9 on any fill, a missing value on either path counting as a disagreement (parity)
notional_weighting: |dw| x NAV on the fill date: sleeve fills in their engine's own NAV units (headline_equity); overlay legs and overlay-induced fills in the deployed blend's NAV units
declared_cells: H-D2 post leg (fill to t+3 close), adverse-oriented, equal-weighted, confirmatory set, against the blocked close-priced placebo (verdict-bearing; floor 10 bp of price)
H-D1 mean u, equal-weighted, confirmatory set, against the same placebo (descriptive headline)
pre leg (t-3 close to fill), adverse-oriented, confirmatory set
buys and sells separately (u, pre, post), confirmatory set
by sleeve (u, pre, post), confirmatory set
by calendar year (u, pre, post), confirmatory set
sleeve-D fills in EUR (u, pre, post), confirmatory set
overlay legs (EEM, SHY) and overlay-induced fills as rows of their own (u, pre, post), confirmatory set
uniform-intraday placebo variant (u, pre, post; all, buys, sells), confirmatory set
pre-blend fills (before 2018-10-31) as a cell of their own (u, pre, post)
H-D2 and H-D1 against the independent-per-fill null and the chained same-line null (disclosures)
leave-one-line-out and leave-one-year-out thinness of the H-D2 effect (and of the H-D1 effect, descriptive), confirmatory set
disabled_pcc_cells: C1 cost anchor: P&L share and commission comparison (amendment c)

H2 tail share, S2 worse than six closes, S4 matched reversal, S5 intraday placement, S6 u at the close, S8 ex-date-excluded H1: not declared by this registration (amendment c, extended on the same principle)
amended: 2026-10-04: amendments 1 to 7 of the PREREG (section Amendments before the freeze)

confirmatory.basis: the deployed blend's inception (Wednesday 2018-10-31); the earlier fills are a disclosure cell, never verdict-bearing (amendment 5)
